signal: Very Good Ventures closed $3.4M from Celesta Capital (total $6.4M Series A) and launched an AI-native Flutter engineering platform

email.subject1: a signal play for Very Good Ventures
email.body1:
Laura, saw Very Good Ventures closed fresh funding and rolled out your AI-native Flutter platform.

Growing services that fast usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before new capacity ramps, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Very Good Ventures off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Laura, quick follow-up for Very Good Ventures.

Post-raise, growth expectations usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Very Good Ventures needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Laura, last bit of proof for Very Good Ventures.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Very Good Ventures's reply rate likely compares to other dev-services firms. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Laura, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and I know the fundraise-to-hiring stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a dev-services motion? I will tailor it to Very Good Ventures either way.
